raw.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The Center of Excellence Engineering Team supports our network of Channel Partners in designing solutions for their customers. The CoEE Team is the conduit for Channel Partners to obtain help in generating proposals, including equipment lists, proposal text, and coverage studies. CoEE develops and maintains tools to enable quick turn proposals to be generated for a variety of system types.

Our Company has an outstanding track record of success and strives to build long term relationships with our customers. Customer satisfaction is given great emphasis and we strive to build a trusted advisor relationship with every customer.

The customer team comprises Sales, Project Management, System Engineering and System Technologist personnel working together in a high performance culture, often with demanding cycle times and high customer expectations because we are working on mission critical communication systems.


Job Description

Many of our systems are designed around the APCO Project 25 Communications Standard. With the growth of data services some of our customer’s mobile wireless networks are being enhanced with LTE infrastructure for applications such as live mobile video transmission supplementing our traditional core voice and narrowband data networks.


The System Engineer will take responsibility for and oversee all technical aspects, along with a senior engineer, of assigned projects from award until system acceptance.


The Presales Engineer is the architect and owner of solution design. This includes development, design, evaluation, and modification of systems and architecture to meet customer requirements. This includes but not limited to:

  • Equipment list generation
  • Description of system design, including diagrams
  • Understanding customer requirements
  • Radio Coverage design and analysis
  • Calculation of power and networking requirements
  • Participation in proposal reviews and contract negotiations

Specific Knowledge/Skills:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science or related field
  • Willingness to think out of the box and challenge the status quo
  • Experience with Google Suite Platform (Docs, Sheets, Forms, etc.)
  • Experience with Google Scripts is highly desirable
  • General knowledge of wireless communications fundamentals and voice/data architectures - both public and private (e.g. APCO P25, LTE, 802.11, 3G/4G)
  • General understanding of IP networking architecture, protocols and security
  • General knowledge of RF coverage predictions, traffic/capacity modeling, and related toolsets
  • Willingness to travel: 10%

Target Base Salary Range: $70,000 - $80,000 USD


Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.



Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree OR 1+ years of experience with Systems Engineering or Wireless Communications

Under 10%

None

Our U.S. Benefits include:

  • Incentive Bonus Plans

  • and more!

Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Masimo, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Masimo is a global medical technology company that develops and produces a wide array of industry-leading monitoring technologies, including non-invasive measurements, sensors, patient monitors, and automation and connectivity solutions. Our mission is, Masimo innovations empower clinicians to transform patient care. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a culture that’s driven by passion, challenging the status quo, and making an impact in the lives of others.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Clinical Sales Representative is responsible for combining clinical expertise with a strong commercial mindset to develop Masimo’s presence across hospitals and private healthcare institutions within the assigned territory. The role builds trusted relationships with clinicians and key decision-makers, identifies business opportunities, and supports customers throughout the sales cycle through product demonstrations, clinical evaluations, implementation and ongoing education.

This position reports to the Country Manager, is part of the Sales Team in Italy and will work remotely to cover Emilia-Romagna and Marche.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Develop and manage relationships with hospitals, private clinics, clinicians, key opinion leaders and other healthcare stakeholders across the assigned territory.
  • Drive sales growth and identify new business opportunities for Masimo’s patient monitoring technologies.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, including account qualification, product demonstrations, clinical evaluations, negotiations, closing and post-sale follow-up.
  • Provide clinical expertise and support for Masimo products, particularly in critical care environments such as Anesthesia, ICU, NICU/PICU and Emergency Care.
  • Conduct product demonstrations, clinical evaluations, customer training and educational sessions for healthcare professionals.
  • Develop strategic account plans and coordinate internal resources to support customer conversions and implementation.
  • Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast, monitor market and competitor activity, and represent Masimo at congresses and relevant clinical or commercial events.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Degree or professional qualification in Biomedical Engineering, Nursing, Medical Technology or another relevant medical/clinical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Previous experience in medical devices, clinical support, clinical sales or healthcare sales.
  • Experience working in hospital environments and with patient monitoring technologies; experience within critical care environments such as ICU, OR, NICU/PICU or Emergency Care is preferred.
  • Fluent Italian and good command of English.
  • Experience delivering product demonstrations, clinical training or presentations to healthcare professionals.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Patient monitoring, pulse oximetry or other critical care technologies.
  • Working with key opinion leaders, clinical bodies, research institutions, OEM partners or distributors.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to travel approximately 60% of the time, with overnight stays as required, within the assigned territory.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record

Masimo, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.


At Masimo we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Masimo can provide.


Base salary and level of employment
This role is classified under the applicable CCNL, which defines minimum terms, job classification, and baseline progression frameworks. The expected gross annual salary range for this role is €45,000 - €63,000, determined based on objective criteria such as experience, skills, and role-related competencies.

This job is also eligible for incentive pay. The target earnings are determined as a percentage of annual base salary, subject to objective eligibility criteria and performance conditions as set out in the applicable scheme terms and conditions.


This job is also eligible for a comprehensive package of benefits. Details regarding these benefits will be provided separately.

raw.title: Sr. Product Counsel
raw.excerpt: As Product & Marketing Counsel, you will serve as a strategic legal partner to our Product and Marketing teams, advising on the development and operation of our consumer marketplace.
raw.description:
As Product & Marketing Counsel, you will serve as a strategic legal partner to our Product and Marketing teams, advising on the development and operation of our consumer marketplace. This role reports directly to the General Counsel and requires a practical, business-minded lawyer who can identify legal risks and build scalable compliance solutions for product and marketing initiatives.

The ideal candidate will help the legal function enable the business by providing clear, practical guidance and using legal technology and AI where appropriate. You will counsel teams on product, marketing, consumer protection, and privacy issues affecting our consumer-facing platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Counseling: Advise Product teams throughout the development lifecycle, including on product design, user flows, payment systems, rate cards, onboarding flows, consumer protection, and launch readiness.

  • Marketing Compliance: Advise on advertising and marketing campaigns, promotional offers, disclosures, consumer claims, and related regulatory requirements. Assist with the development and maintenance of practical toolkits, playbooks, and decision trees that help Marketing teams handle routine compliance matters, including appropriate use of AI and legal-tech tools for copy review and claim verification.

  • Drafting & Governance: Draft and maintain Terms of Service (ToS), Privacy Policies, and EULAs for our consumer-facing products, ensuring they are legally sound and accessible. Review contracts related to consumer products, marketing, and strategic partnerships.

  • Data Privacy: Advise Product and Marketing teams on privacy requirements, including data collection and use, consent, disclosures, cookies and tracking technologies, targeted advertising, and privacy-by-design principles. Identify issues under domestic and global privacy laws, including CCPA/CPRA and GDPR.

  • Legal Expertise: J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • Professional Experience: 7–9 years of legal practice, including at least 3 years of experience advising as product counsel, preferably in-house at a technology company or consumer marketplace.
  • Product, Marketing & Privacy Counseling: Proven experience providing proactive product and marketing advice, including privacy guidance related to product features, data practices, advertising, and customer communications.
  • Consumer Marketplace Experience: Familiarity with legal issues affecting consumer-facing technology platforms, including consumer protection, Section 230, FCRA requirements, platform safety, and consumer disputes.
  • Writing Skills: Strong ability to draft clear, consumer-facing Terms of Use, privacy notices, disclosures, policies, and practical guidance for business teams.
  • Business Enablement: A mindset focused on "enabling" the business through education and systems-thinking rather than just spotting risks.
  • Communication Skills: Ability to explain complex legal risks and practical recommendations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders with preference for ability to render concise advice in writing.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience advising a gig-economy platform or other multi-sided consumer marketplace
  • Demonstrative experience and judgment using AI tooling for legal work.

Available in more than 20 countries, Care.com is the world's leading platform for finding and managing high-quality family care. Care.com is designed to meet the evolving needs of today's families and caregivers, offering everything from household tax and payroll services and customized corporate benefits packages covering the care needs of working families, to innovating new ways for caregivers to be paid and obtain professional benefits. Since 2007, families have relied on Care.com's industry-leading products—from child and elder care to pet care and home care.

Salary Range: $175,000 - $200,000 + Bonus The base salary range above represents the anticipated low and high end of the national salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to work location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Care.com’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include annual bonuses and short- and long-term incentives. In addition, Care.com provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a generous 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO).

Care.com is a consumer tech company with heart. We're on a mission to solve a human challenge we all face: finding great care for the ones we love. We're moms and dads and pet parents. We have parents and grandparents so we understand that everyone, at some point in their lives, could use a helping hand. Our culture and our products reflect that.

Here, entrepreneurs, self-starters, team players, and big thinkers unite behind a common cause. Here, we're applying data analytics, AI, and the latest technologies to solve universal problems and connect people in new ways. If you like having autonomy, if you thrive on collaboration and building new things, and if you're all about using your talent for good, Care.com is the place for you.

raw.title: Business Development Manager (Nationwide, US)
raw.excerpt: Founded in 1920, Eastman is a global specialty materials company that produces a broad range of products found in items people use every day.
raw.description:
Founded in 1920, Eastman is a global specialty materials company that produces a broad range of products found in items people use every day. With the purpose of enhancing the quality of life in a material way, Eastman works with customers to deliver innovative products and solutions while maintaining a commitment to safety and sustainability. The company’s innovation-driven growth model takes advantage of world-class technology platforms, deep customer engagement, and differentiated application development to grow its leading positions in attractive end markets such as transportation, building and construction, and consumables. As a globally inclusive company, Eastman employs approximately 13,000 people around the world and serves customers in more than 100 countries. The company had 2025 revenue of approximately $8.8 billion and is headquartered in Kingsport, Tennessee, USA. For more information, visit www.eastman.com.

Role Profile

The Business Development Manager is expected to expand Eastman’s presence in strategically important markets, improve early access to projects and specifications, strengthen relationships across the value chain, increase the quality of the opportunity pipeline, support higher project win rates, and convert market insights into sustainable commercial growth.

The Business Development Manager is responsible for executing our business strategy at the downstream customer and key value chain partners level, enabling customer success through identifying, developing, and securing new specifications for Eastman Heat Transfer Fluids offerings in existing & emerging applications. This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the way Eastman strategically develops its business through product specification working with process licensors, large engineering, procurement and construction companies & (OEM) Original Equipment Manufacturers in the conventional Oil & Gas Industries, downstream petrochemicals and derivatives and emerging renewable energy / sustainability markets. Approximately 50% + travel is required for this role.

This full-time, remote position is home-office based with a preference for candidates based in Houston, Atlanta, Chicago, St Louis, and Greenville. This is a critical role within the Specialty Fluids & Energy business reporting to the North America / Asia Sales Manager and offers an exciting opportunity to develop new business with our innovation-driven platform offerings in downstream applications.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the commercial team to understand market dynamics, industry trends, customer needs, end-market developments, and emerging applications relevant to the SFE- HTF business. Identify and prioritize attractive market segments, applications, investment projects, and growth opportunities by evaluating market potential, strategic fit, competitive intensity, customer value, and expected return.
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the value chain, including customers, engineering, procurement, and construction companies, process licensors, consultants, technology providers, distributors, and other strategic partners. And, build and maintain a global ecosystem of value-chain partners and decision-makers, working directly or indirectly with the sales, technical, marketing, and regional teams to strengthen Eastman’s market position.
  • Engage with EPC companies, process licensors, engineering firms, and other validation partners involved in conventional markets and emerging growth areas, including renewable energy and sustainability-related applications. Identify opportunities to influence product specifications and technical standards at an early stage of project development, while ensuring that customer and value-chain requirements are clearly communicated to the relevant internal teams
  • Work closely with customers, account managers, and technical teams to understand application requirements, unmet needs and support the development, qualification, and specification of Eastman products and solutions. Translate market, customer, project, and value-chain insights into actionable business recommendations, including opportunity prioritization, commercial strategies, product-development needs, and market-entry plans.
  • Use available business tools, market intelligence, project databases, Salesforce Opportunity Management, Power BI and investment-outlook resources to assess global developments in conventional and emerging markets and to guide the allocation of business-development resources supporting product specification.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Monitor global investment activity, major projects, technology developments, regulatory trends, and sustainability priorities to anticipate future demand and identify opportunities for Eastman.
  • Provide market and competitive intelligence to commercial and business leadership, including insights on competitors, alternative technologies, customer strategies, project pipelines, value propositions, and potential risks. Collaborate with sales, marketing, product management, technical service, application development, supply chain, and other functional teams to develop coordinated customer and project strategies.
  • Support technical validation and commercialization activities by coordinating the required engagement among customers, engineering partners, process licensors, technical teams, and internal stakeholders. Develop and maintain strategic accounts, market, and project plans that define objectives, stakeholders, engagement priorities, value propositions, actions, and expected outcomes.
  • Promote a global, customer-centric approach to business development by encouraging collaboration across regions and avoiding regional silos, particularly on global accounts and projects involving multiple supply or customer locations. Facilitate effective handoffs from business development to the commercial and technical teams, ensuring that project information, customer requirements, timelines, risks, and agreed actions are clearly documented and communicated.
  • Track business-development activities, project progress, customer engagement, specifications, validation milestones, and commercial outcomes using established business processes and systems. Continuously assess the effectiveness of business-development strategies and recommend adjustments when market conditions, customer priorities, competitive dynamics, or investment plans change.
  • Ensure all activities are conducted in accordance with Eastman’s policies, applicable laws, ethical business practices, and health, safety, environmental, and security requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or related engineering field required. Master in business administration (MBA) is preferred.
  • 5–10+ years of advanced Sales / Business development in specialty chemicals, Engineering Procurement and Construction Companies or with Process Licensors. Strong process engineering background working with EPCs is preferred.
  • Extensive knowledge of Process Engineering.
  • Strong technical knowledge, market and customer strategy and planning experience
  • Experience with CRM ( Sales Force preferred), opportunity management and other sales systems and tools
  • Success in the role requires strong strategic thinking, global networking, customer and market orientation, commercial awareness, technical curiosity, influencing skills, collaboration, adaptability, and the ability to connect long-term market opportunities with practical business actions.

  • Note: Eastman will not accept applicants for this offered position who require visa sponsorship, including those whose status is F-1 visa OPT who subsequently would require ongoing visa sponsorship.

Travel Requirements

Required to spend minimum 50% of time on travel status for customer visits; trade shows; training; and regional/global meetings. Travel will mostly be in US and Canada however may also require additional international travel as needed.

Traits

Passion for Selling:

  • Is consistently obsessed with understanding and shaping customer and market behavior
  • Connects the dots to develop insights meaningful to customers’ and Eastman’s success
  • Leverages data for learning, decision making, and prioritization
  • Uses a disciplined approach in developing and following successful patterns in key sales processes

Tenacious:

  • Pursues goals with energy, drive and a need to finish
  • Seldom gives up before finishing, especially in the face of resistance, rejection or set-back
  • Always looks for the possibilities and skillfully does discovery to overcome obstacles
  • Breaks down or work around perceived barriers; gets to the right decision makers internally and externally

Inquisitive:

  • Leverages the skills of questioning, observation, listening and networking to gain a deep understanding of our customers’ goals, needs and issues
  • Takes the required action to resolve gaps in information, knowledge or understanding
  • Gathers all information needed to make informed choices
  • Leverages experts and other key individuals as important sources of information
  • Uncovers relevant information to make accurate judgments and sound decisions

The base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $137,500. ​

At Eastman, we are committed to transparency and integrity in our compensation practices. Eastman includes salary ranges in some job postings to provide clear compensation information and to be compliant with state laws that require disclosure. Not all postings display ranges due to factors like location, market conditions, or position specifics. Compensation is based on qualifications and experience. Candidates are encouraged to discuss their salary questions during the interview process.

Benefits

Your total rewards go far beyond a competitive salary. When you join Eastman, you gain access to an exceptional suite of programs designed to protect your health, grow your wealth, and fuel your career.

Compensation & Incentives
• Base pay plus performance-based incentive opportunities that let you share in our success.

Health & Wellness
• Comprehensive medical, prescription-drug, and dental coverage—paired with a Health Savings Account option to help you save tax-free dollars for care today or in the future.
• A robust menu of voluntary benefits—including vision, optional life, critical-illness protection, and more—so you can tailor coverage to fit your life.
• Holistic wellness support: financial-planning tools, family-building assistance (adoption, pregnancy, and fertility resources), parental leave, and confidential Employee Assistance Program counseling.

Retirement & Financial Strategies
• 401(k) with a company match—plus an additional annual retirement contribution from Eastman to accelerate your long-term savings.

Time Away
• Eleven paid holidays, one personal day, paid time off, and paid vacation to recharge, celebrate, or handle life’s moments.

Growth & Development
• Access to mentorship, learning resources, and leadership programs that empower you to thrive in your current role and chart the next steps in your career.

At Eastman, we invest in the whole you—so you can bring your best self to work every day and build a future you’re proud of.

Eastman Chemical Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, pregnancy, veteran status or any other protected classes as designated by law.

Eastman is committed to creating a powerfully engaged workplace, where everyone can contribute to their fullest potential each day.

raw.description:
Why This Role, Why Now

This is a dual role internally, you’ll be our Director of Global Sales Engineering, leading a team of Sales Engineers supporting a ~$40M book of business; externally, you’ll be our Field CTO, the most credible technical voice ReversingLabs puts in front of CISOs, product security leaders, and conference audiences. You’ll report directly to the CRO and sit on the GTM leadership team.

Is This You?

You’re a genuine player-coach: current enough to run the hard demo yourself, and disciplined enough not to do your team’s job for them. You’ve written the playbook for a technical customer-facing function rather than inherited one, and you can move from a packet capture to a board-level risk conversation in the same afternoon, credible in both.

You’ll be in deals, on whiteboards, and in escalations while building the operating system that lets this function scale well past its current size, and you’ll carry what the market tells you back into Product and Engineering.

At a Glance

Role - Director, Global Sales Engineering & Field CTO

Team - Sales

Location - Remote, USA

Compensation - $200,000 – $210,000 base + commission + equity

Experience -12+ years in technical, customer-facing roles; 5+ years leading a team

Travel - ~30–40% (customers, field events, industry conferences)

What You’ll Own

  • Lead and grow the team
    • Lead, coach, and develop the global Sales Engineering team; own hiring, ramp, career pathing, and performance for the function.
    • Operate as a player-coach, personally engaged in strategic and competitive deals and demonstrating the standard rather than describing it.
    • Assess gaps in evolving skill and training needs, then build and run the programs that close them across sales, product, and technical depth.
    • Design the team’s model for scale: coverage, specialization, capacity planning, and the case for the next hires as the business grows.
  • Own the technical win
    • Improve and codify the technical layer of our sales methodology (discovery, demo, evaluation, and proof of value) so it scales with a rapidly growing sales organization.
    • Interpret prospective customer requirements and translate them into tailored demonstrations and solution designs across the Spectra portfolio.
    • Lead technical evaluation cycles to a decisive technical win; design, validate, and document the solutions that get us there.
    • Own the transition from technical win to successful deployment. A clean handoff into onboarding and production is part of the job, not someone else’s problem.
    • Refine internal processes so performance is measurable, the customer experience is consistent, and the team’s impact on deal outcomes is visible.
  • Be our technical voice in the market (Field CTO)
    • Represent ReversingLabs on stage, on panels, in webinars, in the press, and with industry analysts.
    • Build executive-level technical trust with CISOs, CTOs, and product security leaders: the conversations that happen above the evaluation.
    • Develop and defend our competitive positioning, including against crowdsourced alternatives and legacy AST/SCA tooling, with substance rather than slideware.
    • Develop deep expertise in industry trends, regulatory pressure, and competitive offerings, and make that expertise usable by the whole field team.
    • Partner with Marketing to shape technical content, launches, and field programs that generate pipeline.
  • Close the loop with Product
    • Act as the technical liaison between prospective customers and our Product and Engineering teams.
    • Collect, synthesize, and prioritize field feedback into roadmap influence, bringing evidence, not anecdotes.
    • Provide timely, insightful input to Product Management, Marketing, and business leadership on what is winning, what is losing, and why.
    • Maintain deep expertise in the feature functionality and practical application of all ReversingLabs offerings.
    • Other duties as assigned

What Success Looks Like in Year One

    • First 30 days: You know the products cold enough to demo unaided, you’ve met every member of the team, and you’ve been in front of customers.
    • First 90 days: You have a written point of view on where we lose technical cycles and why, an assessment of team capability against the coverage we need, and the first process changes in flight.
    • First 6 months: Evaluation and proof-of-value execution is measurably more consistent; the technical-win-to-deployment handoff is defined and working; and you’re visible in market as our Field CTO.
    • First 12 months: The function scales without you personally in every deal; field feedback is visibly shaping the roadmap; and technical win rate and evaluation cycle time have both moved in the right direction.

What We're Looking For

Here's what actually matters:

Must Haves

    • Experience: 12+ years in technical, customer-facing roles (sales engineering, solution architecture, professional services, or technical customer success), with 5+ years leading a team.
    • Builder: You’ve built a technical customer-facing function from the ground up at a growth-stage company. You’ve written the playbook, not just inherited one.
    • Player-Coach: You’re current enough to run the hard demo yourself and disciplined enough not to do your team’s job for them.
    • Technical Depth and Breadth: Comfortable deep-diving into a hard problem, and skilled at getting out of a rabbit hole when the deal needs you somewhere else.
    • Executive Presence: You can move from a packet capture to a board-level risk conversation in the same afternoon, and be credible in both.
    • Security Domain Fluency: Software supply chain, malware analysis, threat intelligence, endpoint, SOC operations, OT/ICS, or an adjacent discipline. You don’t need to know our products on day one; you need the technical foundation to own them quickly.
    • Deployment and Adoption Reality: You’ve carried responsibility for what happens after the signature (implementation, integration, escalation), and it shapes how you sell.
    • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; you remove confusion, doubt, and uncertainty rather than add to it.
    • AI-Forward Mindset: You embrace AI and emerging technologies as part of how you work, using them to improve efficiency, solve problems, and deliver better results. You’re curious, open to new ways of working, and willing to experiment, learn, and help others adopt tools and approaches that make us more effective.

Nice to Haves

    • Experience across both enterprise sales-led and product-led growth motions.
    • A public technical voice: conference speaking, published writing, press commentary, analyst relationships, or an engaged community following.
    • Professional services or consulting delivery background, including large-scale enterprise or federal environments.
    • Exposure to third-party risk, procurement, or compliance-driven buying processes.
    • Track record of influencing product roadmap from the field.
    • Comfort in a fluid, fast-paced environment and navigating matrixed organizations.
    • A passion for problem-solving and a roll-up-your-sleeves demeanor.

About ReversingLabs

ReversingLabs is the leader in software supply chain security, helping the world's most security-conscious organizations detect and respond to threats hidden inside software. Our platform is trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies, and security teams globally. We're a company that takes the work seriously and takes care of the people doing it.

Our Hiring Process

We respect your time and want to be upfront about what to expect. Our process typically takes 3-5 weeks and includes:

  1. Application Review - We review every application and aim to respond within 7 business days
  2. Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation to learn about you and share more about the role

Questions along the way? Reach out to Nicole Marquis at .

We look forward to hearing from you.

Das sind Deine Aufgaben:

  • Problem- und Zielbild präzisieren; Forschungsfragen ableiten
  • Herstellerneutrale Funktionslandkarte strukturieren und sauber definieren
  • Bewertungsrahmen konzipieren und iterativ verfeinern (Methodik wählst Du)
  • Praxisfeedback einholen (Interviews/Umfrage/Desk Research) zur Validierung
  • Ergebnisse in klare Entscheidungsvorlagen verdichten (Summary, Checkliste, Matrix)

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Du studierst (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, BWL mit Tech-Fokus oder einen verwandten Studiengang (Bachelor oder Master)
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit Enterprise Architecture und Prozess-management sind von Vorteil
  • Analytische, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, komplexe Themen in klare Modelle/Tabellen zu überführen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Das kannst Du erwarten:

  • Du lernst das fundamentale Handwerkzeug für Digitalisierungsprojekte kennen und stellst dich so optimal im Bereich IT-Management auf
  • Hohe Praxisrelevanz: Deine Ergebnisse fließen direkt in Entwicklungs- & Transformationsprojekte ein
  • Zugang zu Expert:innen aus Industrie & Beratung (Interviews/Feedback-Runden) bieten Raum für eine hohe Softskill-Lernkurve
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit enger fachlicher Betreuung und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Moderne, kollaborative Arbeitsumgebung (remote-freundlich) am FIR und flexible Zeiteinteilung

Ob in der Beratung oder im Konzern: In jedem IT-Transformationsprojekt müssen Organisation und Prozesse von Unternehmen analysiert und neu geplant werden. IT-, Prozess- und Unternehmensmodellierungswerkzeuge sind dafür zentrale Bausteine – decken jedoch meist nur einzelne Perspektiven der (IT-) Organisation ab.

Was fehlt, ist ein klarer, herstellerneutraler Überblick: Welche Funktionen gibt es überhaupt in EAM- und Prozessmodellierungs-Tools, um Transformationen ganzheitlich zu steuern – von Geschäftsarchitektur über Prozesse bis hin zu Anwendungen, Daten und Technologien? In dieser Abschlussarbeit entwickelst Du genau dafür eine systematische Funktionslandkarte samt Bewertungsmethode und lieferst damit eine praktische Entscheidungsgrundlage für Toolauswahl und -architektur in Unternehmen.

  • Structured, analytical and process-oriented way of working.
  • Strong Lean / continuous improvement mindset with the ability to challenge existing ways of working.
  • Ability to identify inefficiencies and turn them into practical and scalable improvements.
  • Strong ownership, prioritization and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience in coordinating or leading people is an advantage.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

raw.title: Senior Data Engineer
raw.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Data and Analytics is a critical team within Business Technology. Our mission is to enable integrated data layers for all of Samsara with the insights, tools, infrastructure to make data-driven decisions. We are a growing team that loves all things data — composed of data engineers, architects, analysts, and data scientists.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer who brings a software engineer's mindset to data infrastructure. This isn't just a pipeline-builder role — we're looking for someone who thinks in systems, builds platforms others can extend, and is excited about pushing the boundaries of what data engineering looks like in an AI-first world. You'll architect Spark-driven workflows at scale, design data platforms as products, and build the next generation of intelligent tooling including MCP servers and AI agents that automate and accelerate data engineering workflows.

Our team promotes an agile, collaborative, and supportive environment where diverse thinking, innovative design, and experimentation are welcomed and encouraged.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development and mastery in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas.
  • You want to build platforms, not just pipelines: You think about data infrastructure as a product, care deeply about developer experience, and want to shape how an engineering team works with data at scale.
  • You're excited about AI-augmented engineering: You want to be at the frontier of how AI agents and intelligent tooling change the way data engineers work.

In this role, you will:

Data Platform Engineering

  • Develop and maintain end-to-end data pipelines and backend ingestion workflows, and participate in the build of Samsara's Data Platform to enable advanced automation and analytics.
  • Work with data from a variety of sources including ERP(Netsuite), CRM(Salesforce), Product, Order Flow, and Support ticket data.
  • Manage critical data pipelines to enable growth initiatives and advanced analytics.
  • Facilitate data integration and transformation for moving data between applications, ensuring interoperability with data layers and the data lake.
  • Develop and improve data architecture, data quality, monitoring, observability, and data availability.
  • Write data transformations in SQL/Python to generate data products consumed by Analytics, Marketing Operations, and Sales Operations teams.

Spark & Distributed Systems

  • Design, build, and operate large-scale Spark and PySpark workflows for batch and streaming data processing across Databricks and cloud environments.
  • Optimize Spark job performance — tuning partitioning, shuffle, caching, and resource allocation for production-grade reliability and efficiency.

Platform & Systems Thinking

  • Define and enforce data engineering standards, patterns, and best practices across the team.
  • Design systems with long-term maintainability in mind: clear contracts, testable components, and thoughtful failure modes.
  • Collaborate with platform and infrastructure teams to evolve the underlying architecture of Samsara's enterprise data ecosystem.

MCP Servers & AI Agents

  • Build and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that expose Samsara's data assets and engineering workflows to AI models and internal tooling.
  • Collaborate with platform teams to integrate agentic workflows into the data engineering lifecycle.
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging AI-native tooling for data engineering, staying ahead of the curve on how LLMs and agents can accelerate data work.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally.
  • Provide mentorship to junior team members and deliver technical guidance, training, and knowledge-sharing across teams.
  • Engage directly with internal cross-functional stakeholders to understand their data needs and design scalable solutions.
  • Lead end-to-end projects as the central point of contact for stakeholders.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, data engineering, data science, information technology, or an equivalent engineering program.
  • 8+ years of work experience as a Software Engineer with data focus or as Data Engineer.
  • 5+ years of experience building and maintaining large-scale, production-grade end-to-end data pipelines, including Data Modeling.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Spark / PySpark in a production environment, including job optimization and performance tuning.
  • Core Engineering Fundamentals: Strong programming capabilities in Python and SQL, combined with cloud data warehouse/lakehouse experience (e.g., Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Databricks, or Apache Iceberg).
  • Exposure to ETL tools such as Fivetran, DBT, or equivalent.
  • API experience: Python-based API frameworks for data pipeline ingestion.
  • RDBMS experience: MySQL, AWS RDS/Aurora, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MS SQL Server, or equivalent.
  • Cloud: AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.

An ideal candidate also has experience in:

  • Designing and governing a centralized semantic layer for reliable AI and analytics
  • Logging and monitoring experience: Splunk, DataDog, AWS CloudWatch, or equivalent.
  • AWS Serverless: API Gateway, Lambda, S3, SNS, SQS, SecretsManager.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$118,107.50—$178,650 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Job Summary

We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to develop visually compelling marketing materials that enhance brand awareness, support digital marketing initiatives, and drive audience engagement. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating graphics for websites, social media, advertising campaigns, presentations, email marketing, video content, and other digital assets.

The ideal candidate has strong design skills, a keen eye for detail, and experience producing high-quality visual content that aligns with branding and marketing objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Graphic Design & Brand Development
  • Create visually appealing designs that align with the company’s brand identity and marketing goals.
  • Develop and maintain consistent branding across all digital and print materials.
  • Design marketing collateral, promotional materials, and branded assets for various campaigns.
  • Ensure all designs meet brand guidelines and maintain a professional appearance.

Social Media Design
  • Create engaging graphics, carousels, banners, infographics, and promotional materials for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other social platforms.
  • Design social media content that supports audience engagement and brand awareness initiatives.
  • Develop creative assets optimized for each platform's specifications and best practices.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to support content calendars and campaign launches.

Website & Digital Marketing Assets
  • Design website graphics, banners, landing page visuals, icons, and other digital assets.
  • Create visuals that support SEO, lead generation, and conversion-focused marketing initiatives.
  • Collaborate with web developers to ensure design consistency and user experience optimization.
  • Develop graphics for blogs, newsletters, and email marketing campaigns.

Advertising & Campaign Design
  • Design creative assets for Google Ads, Facebook Ads, LinkedIn Ads, display ads, and retargeting campaigns.
  • Create high-converting visual content for paid advertising initiatives.
  • Develop A/B testing variations for advertising creatives.
  • Ensure advertising materials comply with brand and campaign requirements.

Presentation & Corporate Materials
  • Design professional presentations, pitch decks, investor materials, reports, and corporate documents.
  • Create infographics and visual data representations to simplify complex information.
  • Support internal and external communication materials with professional design elements.

Video Support Graphics

  • Design motion graphic elements, title cards, lower thirds, and overlays for video content.

Creative Collaboration

Das sind Deine Aufgaben:

  • Problem- und Zielbild präzisieren; Forschungsfragen ableiten
  • Herstellerneutrale Funktionslandkarte strukturieren und sauber definieren
  • Bewertungsrahmen konzipieren und iterativ verfeinern (Methodik wählst Du)
  • Praxisfeedback einholen (Interviews/Umfrage/Desk Research) zur Validierung
  • Ergebnisse in klare Entscheidungsvorlagen verdichten (Summary, Checkliste, Matrix)

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Du studierst (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, BWL mit Tech-Fokus oder einen verwandten Studiengang (Bachelor oder Master)
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit Enterprise Architecture und Prozess-management sind von Vorteil
  • Analytische, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, komplexe Themen in klare Modelle/Tabellen zu überführen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Das kannst Du erwarten:

  • Du lernst das fundamentale Handwerkzeug für Digitalisierungsprojekte kennen und stellst dich so optimal im Bereich IT-Management auf
  • Hohe Praxisrelevanz: Deine Ergebnisse fließen direkt in Entwicklungs- & Transformationsprojekte ein
  • Zugang zu Expert:innen aus Industrie & Beratung (Interviews/Feedback-Runden) bieten Raum für eine hohe Softskill-Lernkurve
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit enger fachlicher Betreuung und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Moderne, kollaborative Arbeitsumgebung (remote-freundlich) am FIR und flexible Zeiteinteilung

Ob in der Beratung oder im Konzern: In jedem IT-Transformationsprojekt müssen Organisation und Prozesse von Unternehmen analysiert und neu geplant werden. IT-, Prozess- und Unternehmensmodellierungswerkzeuge sind dafür zentrale Bausteine – decken jedoch meist nur einzelne Perspektiven der (IT-) Organisation ab.

Was fehlt, ist ein klarer, herstellerneutraler Überblick: Welche Funktionen gibt es überhaupt in EAM- und Prozessmodellierungs-Tools, um Transformationen ganzheitlich zu steuern – von Geschäftsarchitektur über Prozesse bis hin zu Anwendungen, Daten und Technologien? In dieser Abschlussarbeit entwickelst Du genau dafür eine systematische Funktionslandkarte samt Bewertungsmethode und lieferst damit eine praktische Entscheidungsgrundlage für Toolauswahl und -architektur in Unternehmen.

raw.title: Senior Data Engineer
raw.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Data and Analytics is a critical team within Business Technology. Our mission is to enable integrated data layers for all of Samsara with the insights, tools, infrastructure to make data-driven decisions. We are a growing team that loves all things data — composed of data engineers, architects, analysts, and data scientists.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer who brings a software engineer's mindset to data infrastructure. This isn't just a pipeline-builder role — we're looking for someone who thinks in systems, builds platforms others can extend, and is excited about pushing the boundaries of what data engineering looks like in an AI-first world. You'll architect Spark-driven workflows at scale, design data platforms as products, and build the next generation of intelligent tooling including MCP servers and AI agents that automate and accelerate data engineering workflows.

Our team promotes an agile, collaborative, and supportive environment where diverse thinking, innovative design, and experimentation are welcomed and encouraged.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development and mastery in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas.
  • You want to build platforms, not just pipelines: You think about data infrastructure as a product, care deeply about developer experience, and want to shape how an engineering team works with data at scale.
  • You're excited about AI-augmented engineering: You want to be at the frontier of how AI agents and intelligent tooling change the way data engineers work.

In this role, you will:

Data Platform Engineering

  • Develop and maintain end-to-end data pipelines and backend ingestion workflows, and participate in the build of Samsara's Data Platform to enable advanced automation and analytics.
  • Work with data from a variety of sources including ERP(Netsuite), CRM(Salesforce), Product, Order Flow, and Support ticket data.
  • Manage critical data pipelines to enable growth initiatives and advanced analytics.
  • Facilitate data integration and transformation for moving data between applications, ensuring interoperability with data layers and the data lake.
  • Develop and improve data architecture, data quality, monitoring, observability, and data availability.
  • Write data transformations in SQL/Python to generate data products consumed by Analytics, Marketing Operations, and Sales Operations teams.

Spark & Distributed Systems

  • Design, build, and operate large-scale Spark and PySpark workflows for batch and streaming data processing across Databricks and cloud environments.
  • Optimize Spark job performance — tuning partitioning, shuffle, caching, and resource allocation for production-grade reliability and efficiency.

Platform & Systems Thinking

  • Define and enforce data engineering standards, patterns, and best practices across the team.
  • Design systems with long-term maintainability in mind: clear contracts, testable components, and thoughtful failure modes.
  • Collaborate with platform and infrastructure teams to evolve the underlying architecture of Samsara's enterprise data ecosystem.

MCP Servers & AI Agents

  • Build and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that expose Samsara's data assets and engineering workflows to AI models and internal tooling.
  • Collaborate with platform teams to integrate agentic workflows into the data engineering lifecycle.
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging AI-native tooling for data engineering, staying ahead of the curve on how LLMs and agents can accelerate data work.

Leadership & Collaboration

raw.description:
Anteris® Technologies is a global structural heart company dedicated to revolutionizing cardiac care. With offices in Minneapolis, MN, US; Geneva, Switzerland; and Brisbane and Perth, Australia, we have a growing and inclusive team.

Our mission is to forge new frontiers in cardiac care by pioneering science-driven and measurable advancements to restore heart valve patients to healthy function. Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR) technologies were originally designed for older, high-risk patients. Today, younger, more active patients need a better solution that will not just open and close but restore healthy heart function. We seek to restore healthy blood flow patterns by creating the world’s first biomimetic TAVR valve, DurAVR® THV. This cutting-edge valve, incorporating our proprietary ADAPT® anti-calcification technology, is designed to mimic the natural function of a healthy heart valve.

Anteris® Technologies is a global structural heart company dedicated to revolutionizing cardiac care. With offices in Minneapolis, MN, US; Geneva, Switzerland; and Brisbane and Perth, Australia, we have a growing and inclusive team.

Our mission is to forge new frontiers in cardiac care by pioneering science-driven and measurable advancements to restore heart valve patients to healthy function. Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement technologies were originally designed for older, high-risk patients. Today, younger, more active patients need a better solution that will not just open and close but restore healthy heart function. We seek to restore healthy blood flow patterns by creating the world’s first biomimetic TAVR valve, DurAVR® THV. This cutting-edge valve, incorporating our proprietary ADAPT® anti-calcification technology, is designed to mimic the natural function of a healthy heart valve.

The Professional Education Manager is a newly created role within Global Medical Affairs responsible for developing and delivering physician education programs that advance scientific understanding of DurAVR® THV and support readiness for potential future launches, subject to applicable regulatory approvals.

Reporting to the Global Medical Affairs Senior Director, this role manages key opinion leader (KOL) faculty engagement, Speakers Bureau operations, congress education, and curriculum development. Working closely with Medical Affairs, Marketing, and Compliance, this person ensures education is scientifically accurate, relevant to healthcare professionals, and appropriate to the product’s regulatory status in each market.

The ideal candidate combines cardiovascular scientific knowledge with experience managing physician education programs and translating complex clinical evidence into engaging, practical learning.

Location: Remote role based in North America (US or Canada) or Europe (France, Germany, UK, Netherlands, or Switzerland).

At Anteris Technologies, you’ll be part of a growing team working to revolutionize structural heart care and improve the lives of patients with aortic stenosis.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Scientific Expertise and Content Development
• Develop a thorough understanding of DurAVR, ADAPT technology, valve hemodynamics, flow restoration science, and the PARADIGM clinical trial.
• Develop and maintain healthcare professional (HCP) educational content aligned with the Medical Affairs evidence strategy and applicable review and approval processes.
• Prepare KOL faculty and other HCP presenters to discuss relevant scientific evidence at congresses, advisory boards, and investigator meetings.
• Stay current on structural heart research, TAVR clinical evidence, and emerging approaches to evaluating valve performance and patient outcomes.
• Partner with Medical Affairs colleagues to ensure educational materials accurately communicate available evidence, its limitations, and the product’s regulatory status.

Speakers Bureau and Faculty Engagement
• Manage day-to-day operations of the Anteris Speakers Bureau, including faculty coordination, scheduling, presentation review, speaker preparation, and post-program follow-up.
• Build productive relationships with physician faculty and collaborate with Medical Affairs leadership to identify educational needs and appropriate speakers.
• Coordinate with Compliance and relevant internal partners to ensure required contracts, fair market value assessments, and approvals are completed before engagements.
• Maintain timely and accurate engagement records and support applicable transfers of value reporting and disclosure requirements.
• Track program reach, faculty engagement, participant feedback, and educational effectiveness to guide improvements.

Congress Education
• Lead planning and execution of Anteris professional education activities at major cardiovascular congresses, including TCT, EuroPCR, NY Valves, ESC, CRT, and EACTS.
• Collaborate with the Global Medical Affairs Senior Director and KOL faculty to develop relevant symposia, workshops, and case-based education.
• Manage the congress education calendar, speaker assignments, content development timelines, and program readiness.
• Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to deliver well-organized programs that meet scientific, operational, and compliance expectations.
• Collect and evaluate participant feedback to improve future programming.

Curriculum and Digital Education
• Develop and maintain the annual Professional Education Plan, including learning objectives, target audiences, program formats, digital education priorities, and congress activities.
• Design educational modules addressing valve hemodynamics, flow restoration science, patient–prosthesis mismatch, and clinical trial design and evidence.
• Develop digital learning approaches, including webinars, e-learning, and online case libraries, to extend access beyond live events.
• Work with the Associate Director of Medical Affairs to align educational programming with the publication pipeline, emerging evidence, and faculty needs.
• Adapt educational content for regional audiences and the product’s regulatory status in each market.
• Establish measures of learning, engagement, and program effectiveness to inform future education priorities.

Skills, Knowledge, Experience & Qualifications

Required
• Bachelor’s degree in a clinical, life science, or related discipline.
• 10+ years of relevant experience in medical affairs, professional education, clinical education, or a related medical device function, including direct responsibility for physician education programs.
• Experience coordinating physician faculty or speaker programs in a regulated medical device environment.
• Strong scientific literacy in cardiovascular medicine, with the ability to interpret clinical evidence and discuss valve performance, hemodynamics, and clinical trial design with physician faculty.
• Demonstrated ability to translate complex scientific information into clear, engaging educational content.
• Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs, stakeholders, and deadlines.
• Understanding of HCP engagement compliance, including contracting, fair market value, applicable transparency reporting, and regional industry codes.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Ability to travel approximately 30–40%, including internationally for congresses, faculty engagements, and investigator meetings.

Preferred
• Advanced degree in a clinical or life science discipline, such as an MSc, MPH, PhD, PharmD, or MD.
• Experience in structural heart therapies or TAVR.
• Direct experience managing a physician Speakers Bureau.
• Experience supporting education during pivotal medical device trials or preparation for market authorization and launch.
• Familiarity with TAVR clinical and hemodynamic measures, including effective orifice area, mean pressure gradient, patient–prosthesis mismatch, and ventricular remodeling.
• Experience developing digital education programs or applying adult learning principles to HCP education.
• Experience with speaker management, congress planning, or customer relationship management platforms.
• Proficiency in an additional European language, particularly French, German, or Dutch.

What We Offer
• An opportunity to build and shape a growing global professional education program.
• A high-visibility role advancing scientific understanding of DurAVR and supporting education throughout clinical development and potential future launches.
• Direct collaboration with leading structural heart physicians across Europe and North America.
• A science-driven Medical Affairs team with opportunities to contribute ideas and establish new programs.
• Competitive compensation commensurate with experience and location.

Note: We may require proof of COVID-19 vaccination to comply with health institutions, state, local municipality, and/or travel regulations.

Anteris Technologies recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We have a clear vision: to be a place of belonging for all humans by promoting diversity, multiculturism and inclusion, as a goal and reflection across the organization. Diversity is more than a commitment - it is part of our mission to deliver the best structural heart products on a global scale.

The Special Education Mentor supports students through a combination of co-teaching in general education settings and targeted lab instruction aligned to individualized learning needs. This role focuses on delivering specialized instruction in either Math or Language Arts/Study Skills while fostering student growth, independence, and academic success.

Essential Duties (Top 5 Roles)

Reading

Writing

Math

Study Skills

3) Content-Specific Instructional Role

  • Serve in a clearly defined instructional focus area:
    • Math Mentor: Deliver math intervention and support numeracy skill development through both co-teaching and lab instruction
    • Language Arts/Study Skills Mentor: Deliver reading, writing, and study skills instruction through both co-teaching and lab instruction
      Plan and deliver instruction aligned to both general education curriculum and specialized learning needs
  • Ensure consistency between co-taught classes and lab-based interventions

4) Progress Monitoring & Data Tracking

  • Track student progress toward academic and skill-based goals
  • Use data to inform instructional decisions and interventions
  • Communicate progress with internal stakeholders as needed

5) Collaboration & Program Support

  • Partner with academic teams to ensure alignment of support strategies
  • Contribute to a positive, student-centered learning environment

Non-Essential Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of the activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time, with or without notice.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a virtual or online learning environment
  • Experience co-teaching in inclusive classroom settings
  • Familiarity with digital learning platforms and tools
  • Experience supporting students with executive functioning and study skills development

Working Conditions

Benefits

After meeting the eligibility requirements, benefits are available, including Health, 401(k) Retirement, Paid Holidays, and Paid Time Off.

Salary Range

  • 25 hours per week
  • $40 per hour

We are seeking a highly motivated Corporate Development Associate to support the evaluation and execution of acquisitions, strategic investments, partnerships, and other growth initiatives. As a world class asset-based carrier, Charger Logistics specializes in delivering assets, on time and on budget. With the diverse fleet of equipment, we can handle a range of freight, including dedicated loads, specialized hauls, temperature controlled goods and HAZMAT cargo.

Charger logistics invests time and support into its employees to provide them with the room to learn and grow their expertise and work their way up. We are entrepreneurial-minded organization that welcomes and support individual idea and strategies. We are currently expanding and looking to add a motivated individual to our team.

We are seeking a hands-on Transportation Claims & Subrogation Specialist to support our self-insured transportation and logistics operations.

The ideal candidate will have experience handling commercial auto/trucking claims, bodily injury, property damage, liability and subrogation. This role will be responsible for reviewing claims, investigating liability, identifying recovery opportunities, initiating subrogation, and negotiating directly with insurers, adjusters, attorneys and other involved parties.

    • Review and manage commercial transportation claims involving bodily injury, property damage and liability.
    • Investigate accidents and determine liability using police reports, statements, dashcam footage, telematics and supporting documentation.
    • Identify and initiate subrogation and recovery opportunities.
    • Prepare and issue subrogation demands with supporting evidence and documentation.
    • Negotiate disputed liability, recoveries and settlements with insurance carriers, adjusters, attorneys and third parties.

    • Manage litigated or high-exposure claims in coordination with defense counsel and external vendors.
    • Pursue recoveries, contribution and indemnification where applicable.
    • Maintain accurate claim documentation and ensure timely follow-up through final resolution.
    • Work closely with Safety, Operations, Legal and Risk Management teams.

Requirements

    • 5+ years of claims experience, preferably within commercial auto, trucking or transportation.
    • Strong hands-on experience with subrogation and claims recovery.
    • Experience handling bodily injury, property damage and liability claims.
    • Strong knowledge of claims investigation and liability assessment.
    • Proven negotiation experience with insurers, adjusters, attorneys and other third parties.
    • Experience with reserving, settlement evaluation and litigated claims.
    • Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills.
    • Ability to independently manage claims from initial review through settlement or recovery.

Preferred

  • Experience working with a self-insured transportation company, fleet, TPA or large deductible/SIR program.

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Senior ABM Strategist leads B2B account-based marketing and go-to-market strategy across complex client accounts, with a strong emphasis on 6sense, Clay, audience strategy, account prioritization, and activation-ready planning. This role helps clients clarify who they should be targeting, why those audiences matter, how to prioritize them, and how to activate against them across marketing and sales. This person is both strategic and hands-on. One day, they may be leading a client through ICP, persona, buying committee, or target account recommendations. The next, they may be pressure-testing 6sense segment logic, advising on 6QA and buying stage strategy, building or QAing a TAL in Clay, or translating account insights into paid media, sales enablement, and campaign recommendations.

The Senior ABM Strategist is highly client-facing and must be comfortable turning ambiguous B2B challenges into clear plans, usable frameworks, activation-ready audiences, and confident next steps. They understand long sales cycles, buying committees, account-based motions, and the importance of aligning marketing, sales, RevOps, and client stakeholders around a shared GTM strategy.

Role Requirements:
